reviews.review_description:
It's so hard to describe this, as it really is such a different game. The art style is cool, and I love the way that, as you progress, you learn a little more about how to play and are given a few more tools to help you get through each level.

I'm only a few areas in, but I've played enough to get a real feel for it, and I know I'll be back to see where my 'memory' and journey take me.

HOLY MOLY, never seen a game like this on Meta Quest, just the most unique game I have ever played.

The puzzles are genuinely genius, pick your path and make the right move.

This should not be this fun, it’s a simple concept but just brilliant the way it’s been constructed.

If you are looking for something completely different, this has to be the game for you.
